body: All seven goals met and merged to main, released as 6.0.0 and installed locally. Eight pull requests: 191, 193, 194 and 195 in the first session; 196 merge, 197 briefing, 198 resolver, 199 writers, 200 skills and 201 release in this one. Final main 4458ba76, suite 814 pass 0 fail, typecheck exit 0, all eight CI checks green on every merge.U+000AU+000AWhat a fresh session now gets: park_thread stores what a session landed alongside the single next action; artifacts are writable, merged and tombstoned so a removal survives a sync; the briefing shows what landed before what to do next and hides retired entries; resolve_conflict can settle every field the merge can produce; and both skills teach the record's purpose rather than only its call sequence.U+000AU+000AThree plan defects were corrected rather than followed. Its census compared two hand-written lists and could not have caught the bug U3 fixed. Its preflight placement would have broken a green test encoding the duty to stop on the briefing. Its prescribed skill wording failed two of this project's skill censuses, so it was written without running them. Red-on-parent predictions were stale three times, all written against parent 3d3148fe before U2 landed.U+000AU+000ANine risks stay open on the record. The load-bearing ones: a retired artifact or risk still renders on logbook://thread/{id} while the briefing hides it, blocked on what the content census's synthesised fixtures mean; park_thread checks session ownership only when thread_id is omitted; artifact label and pointer are stored unescaped with no forgery probe; tombstones accumulate against the record byte cap whose refusal advises a removal retirement can no longer perform; and criterionContent silently discards a diverging criterion result.U+000AU+000ANot verified: nothing here exercised the 6.0.0 server. It is installed and a restart loads it, but every receipt was measured against source or the 5.0.0 build. The first real proof will be a briefing that renders a Landed block.
